checks.method: Recomputed canonical SHA-256 hashes of snapshot, contract and roster and the byte hash of manuscript; inspected the exact alpha roster entry and the revised manuscript.
checks.observation: All expected hashes matched, including manuscript 529389d30265046b63d2082aeffe5fef0db73a17b5083a724d06721c4ee1ff62 and snapshot 24271b347fc88951e8452a2b73e02bbc873403d9211341187c2678c3aa5c6fe7. The original neighbourhood revision is satisfied by Section 3 and the later uses.

checks.method: Read pinned repository/paper/main.tex lines 465-509, checking separately the degree-six, degree-one, degree-five and remaining degree-two-to-four cases; reconstructed the stated six-point catalogue with a fresh bounded Python standard-library enumeration.
checks.observation: The arbitrary-support argument reduces to at most seven points; the no-degree-one maximum-degree-four case actually has at most six. Enumerating all 15,360 selections of seven complementary pairs with orientations produced exactly 1,860 SF3 families. The seven displayed representatives have disjoint orbit sizes 120,360,60,240,360,360,360 and their union equals that full enumerated set. The analytic seven-point case remains H7.
checks.scope: Universal seven-member intersecting triple catalogue on arbitrary support

checks.method: For each literal H0-H7 from pinned main.tex, independently tested every singleton and pair trace X for a pair h1,h2 satisfying h1 intersection h2 = h1 intersection X = h2 intersection X.
checks.observation: All allowed-trace lists match main.tex lines 506-529 exactly: H0/H1 allow 01,02,12; H2 adds 0; H3/H4 allow none; H5 allows 01,23; H6 allows 0,12; H7 allows 5,6,23,56. Since outside points do not change intersections with either witness, each excluded trace is excluded with arbitrary exterior completion. Allowed traces were not treated as jointly realizable.
checks.scope: Mixed-trace obstruction for all eight I7 representatives

checks.method: Read LOW15-R15-rho7-classification.md in full and compared its six-core reduction with pinned main.tex lines 574-611; checked the H6/H7 eliminations and the one/two uv-triple counts directly.
checks.observation: The mandatory mixed triples in H6 and H7 follow from the actual rho<=7 guard and eight-member complement. The H2 restrictions derive from pair capacities and forbidden witnesses before the old final size-16 count. The new proof supplies separate size-15 counts and preserves the exact rho=7 premise; it does not import the old exclusion of 16-member rho<=6 families as an exclusion at 15. No missing size-15 case was identified in this source comparison.
checks.scope: Use of the prior H2 shape reduction at target 15

checks.method: Expanded the displayed four-hub/two-triad R16 formula and directly computed support, degrees, maximum disjointness and anchor degree patterns after one representative hub deletion and one representative outer deletion.
checks.observation: The hub deletion gives degree multiset 4,4,4,4,4,4,5,5,5,6; the outer deletion gives 3,3,4,4,4,4,5,6,6,6. Both have rho=7 and neither has an actual triple with degree pattern (2,4,4) or (3,3,4), matching LOW15-R15-rho7-classification.md, Useful degree consequences. This checks those model consequences, not by itself the universal classification.
checks.scope: Literal R16 deletion consequences used by low-degree prerequisites

checks.method: Read C5-internal-compatibility.md, General structural lemma, Proof at size sixteen, Sizes seventeen through twenty and Translation; compared the R16 and high-link source statements in pinned main.tex.
checks.observation: The complete-C5 argument excludes the R16 alternative because its degrees are 6 and 4, retains possible Q8 leaf sharing, and derives separated support without assuming it for arbitrary size-16 links. At higher sizes it uses the universal high-link theorem. Its deletion consequence retains the complete five-cycle star while removing only internal cycle covers, so it does not replace a complete-link premise by five selected cones. This selected ordinary bridge does not rely on the later degree-18 guard.
checks.scope: Complete-C5 bridge and import circularity boundary

findings.disposition: The required universal quantifier is now explicit in Section 3 and retained in Sections 5.1 and 6.
findings.statement: The manuscript now defines N[max] as the maximum closed neighbourhood cardinality over all actual members and defines an N43 anchor. The graph minimum-degree deductions use N[max] explicitly.

findings.disposition: The selected catalogue and shape arguments were checked below; the new target-15 rho<=6 proof trees remain a separate subsequent audit obligation.
findings.statement: The exact-rho7 classification uses the universal I7 catalogue and mixed-trace obstruction, rather than transferring the old target-16 rho<=6 exhaustion to target 15. The source map correctly distinguishes these inputs.

revisions.action: Inspected the revised scalar definition, N43-anchor definition, graph-degree identity, and subsequent N[max] upper-bound uses.
revisions.result: Section 3 states N[max]=max over actual R of |N[R]| and explicitly says N[max]<=c is universal. Sections 5.1 and 6 use this notation. The ambiguity identified in alpha-framing-001 is removed.

content.summary: The Round 1 neighbourhood-quantifier revision is resolved. Source-map scrutiny and a bounded independent reconstruction support the imported I7 catalogue, its arbitrary-exterior trace obstruction, and the exact-rho7 bridge inspected here. No new uncovered premise or counterexample was found in these checks. Continue to the remaining proof and finite-evidence audits; this is not final theorem acceptance.
